templates.title: qnop
templates.name: qnop
templates.description: Document review platform: line-precise PDF/Word annotations, threaded discussions, version-aware re-anchoring, workflow that only finalizes when every annotation is resolved, teams/roles, OIDC SSO and audit trail. AGPL-3.0 Community edition.
templates.note: Requires strong secrets — generate with `openssl rand -base64 48` (JWT secret, encryption key, passwords) and `openssl rand -hex 32` (encryption salt, MUST be hex). The initial admin password is printed once to the qnop container log on first start. Docs: https://github.com/qnophq/qnop/blob/main/docs/DEPLOYMENT.md
